description: Evaluate mode B building block: standalone LID on VAD utterances or speaker turns. Measure accuracy vs utterance length (0.5–3 s), latency, memory alongside live stack. Explore restricting to a user-declared language set and using speaker-level language priors (a person's usual language).
title: Spike: per-utterance/per-turn LID via WebNN (ECAPA VoxLingua107, Whisper/Qwen3 encoder LID)
